description: Figure 10 illustrates the model’s evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) on the y-axis, plotted against the activated parameters ratio (%) on the x-axis, which ranges from 25% to 100% in increments of 25, with tick labels at 25, 50, 75, and 100. The y-axis scale is linear, spanning from approximately 11.5 to 14.0. Four distinct lines represent different model configurations: a dashed red line labeled “Transformer” remains nearly constant at approximately 11.5; a gray dashed line labeled “Only MoHD FFN” starts at about 11.5 and slightly increases to 12.0; a solid blue line labeled “Only MoHD ATTN” begins near 11.5 and rises to approximately 13.5; and a blue line with star markers labeled “MoHD ATTN + MLP” starts near 11.5 and increases to approximately 13.0.
